EB-gMCR: Energy-Based Generative Modeling for Signal Unmixing and Multivariate Curve Resolution

EB-gMCR：面向信号解混与多元曲线分辨的基于能量生成建模

Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

The paper formulates sparse mixture recovery as a generative model, proves identifiability under a spark condition, and presents an energy-based solver that recovers components and decodes new mixtures. Its reusable component decomposition and generalization to new combinations make composition central; the solver is not an AI model-mechanism or reasoning contribution, and the application setting alone does not raise those scores.

本文将稀疏混合物恢复表述为生成模型，在 spark 条件下证明其可辨识性，并提出一种能够恢复组分并解码新混合物的基于能量的求解器。可复用的组分分解以及对新组合的泛化使组合性成为核心；该求解器并非关于 AI 模型机制或推理的贡献，应用场景本身也不应提高这些方面的评分。

阅读摘要 Abstract

ENGLISH

A measurement of a mixture is the sum of a few component profiles, each weighted by a concentration, and multivariate curve resolution (MCR) recovers both from many samples. Classical MCR factorizes the data matrix, takes the component count as input, and leaves a rotational ambiguity. This paper instead models the generative process, generative MCR (gMCR): each sample selects a few components from a fixed set and is observed as their linear superposition plus noise. We prove that the data determine which decomposition a solver should reach. Under a spark condition on the component profiles, the decomposition of minimal usage is the true one, up to a relabeling of the components, and under noise the same holds up to a stated conjecture. Components recovered this way decode new samples of the same process. EB-gMCR, an energy-based solver, is one realization of gMCR: a gate selects components per sample and is trained toward minimal usage. With no count given, it recovers the component count to within a few percent on synthetic mixtures of up to 256 components, at a sample-to-component ratio of eight and a signal-to-noise ratio of 30 dB. On two public spectroscopy datasets it recovers the count exactly and reconstructs as well as the best method at that count. The trained model, frozen, decodes mixtures synthesized across the concentration simplex at the noise floor. gMCR applies to any sparse linear mixture of a fixed set of components. The results cover a solver whose candidate pool is at least as large as the true component count.

中文

混合物的测量值是少数几个组分谱型按各自浓度加权后的总和，而多元曲线分辨（MCR）通过多个样本恢复这些组分谱型及其浓度。传统 MCR 对数据矩阵进行因式分解，将组分数量作为输入，并存在旋转歧义。本文转而对生成过程建模，称为生成式 MCR（gMCR）：每个样本从固定集合中选取少数组分，并以它们的线性叠加加噪声的形式被观测。我们证明，数据能够决定求解器应当得到哪种分解。在组分谱型满足 spark 条件时，使用组分数最少的分解就是真实分解，仅组分标签可能不同；在有噪声的情况下，在所述猜想成立的条件下也有相同结论。以此方式恢复的组分可以解码同一过程生成的新样本。EB-gMCR 是 gMCR 的一种基于能量的求解器实现：门控模块为每个样本选择组分，并通过训练使组分使用量最小化。在未给定组分数量时，它在最多含 256 个组分的合成混合物上能将组分数量恢复到误差仅为几个百分点以内；样本与组分之比为八，信噪比为 30 dB。在两个公开的光谱数据集上，它准确恢复了组分数量，重建效果也与该组分数量下的最佳方法相当。冻结后的训练模型能够在浓度单纯形上解码合成混合物，且误差达到噪声下限。gMCR 适用于由固定组分集合构成的任意稀疏线性混合。结果涵盖候选组分池大小至少等于真实组分数量的求解器。

Infographics as a Visual Language: Learning through Context and Reconstruction

信息图作为一种视觉语言：通过上下文与重建进行学习

Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

CoReL trains models to connect numerical meaning, visual expression, and contextual compatibility, with reconstruction tasks and evaluation that support transfer across infographic elements. Numerical reasoning and chart question answering are part of the work, but the main contribution is learning compositional infographic understanding rather than reasoning mechanisms generally.

CoReL 训练模型将数值含义、视觉表达和上下文兼容性联系起来，并通过重建任务及评估支持模型在信息图元素之间迁移。数值推理和图表问答也是论文的一部分，但其主要贡献是学习信息图的组合式理解，而非一般意义上的推理机制。

阅读摘要 Abstract

ENGLISH

Advances in multimodal models have improved chart understanding and image generation, yet it remains unclear how well these models capture the relationships that make an infographic meaningful. Infographics communicate through a visual language in which numerical values, text, and graphical elements constrain and complement one another. We introduce **CoReL (Contextual Reconstruction Learning)**, a data construction and pretraining recipe for learning infographic visual language through contextual reconstruction. CoReL organizes learning around three complementary tasks—**Numerical Reasoning**, **Numerical Rendering**, and **Contextual Synthesis**—that connect numerical meaning, visual expression, and contextual compatibility. We build **InfoContext**, a training corpus of **1.7M images** with **27M numerical-text bounding boxes** and **22M graphical bounding boxes**. We also introduce **InfoContext-Bench**, a human-annotated benchmark spanning the three tasks. We apply CoReL to an existing unified understanding-and-generation model through element-masked reconstruction. Experiments reveal substantial limitations in the evaluated public models, even when additional information about the missing content is provided, while our model achieves stronger performance across all three tasks. Numerical-reasoning pretraining with CoReL further improves downstream chart question answering on both **BAGEL and Qwen**, with consistent gains across benchmarks. These results establish contextual reconstruction as an effective framework for learning infographic visual language, with benefits extending from element completion to reasoning across chart elements.

中文

多模态模型的进步提升了图表理解和图像生成能力，但这些模型在多大程度上捕捉到了赋予信息图意义的关系，仍不清楚。信息图通过一种视觉语言进行表达，其中数值、文本和图形元素彼此约束、相互补充。我们提出 **CoReL（Contextual Reconstruction Learning，上下文重建学习）**，这是一套通过上下文重建学习信息图视觉语言的数据构建与预训练方案。CoReL 围绕三个互补任务组织学习——**数值推理**、**数值渲染**和**上下文综合**——将数值含义、视觉表达和上下文兼容性联系起来。我们构建了 **InfoContext**，一个包含 **1.7M 张图像**、**27M 个数值文本边界框**和 **22M 个图形边界框**的训练语料库。我们还推出了 **InfoContext-Bench**，一个涵盖这三项任务的人工标注基准。我们通过元素掩码重建，将 CoReL 应用于现有的统一理解与生成模型。实验揭示，所评估的公开模型存在明显局限，即使提供有关缺失内容的额外信息也是如此；而我们的模型在全部三项任务上表现更强。使用 CoReL 进行数值推理预训练，还能提升 BAGEL 和 Qwen 在下游图表问答任务中的表现，并在各个基准上带来一致的提升。这些结果确立了上下文重建作为学习信息图视觉语言的有效框架，并证明其收益从元素补全延伸到了跨图表元素推理。
